patterns.note: Full-width dark background sections with content centered and constrained, creating a cinematic feel with ample vertical spacing between major content blocks.

Prominent, oversized sans-serif headings in white for hero and section titles, contrasted with smaller, lighter-weight sans-serif for body text and legal disclaimers, all using a consistent brand typeface.
High-contrast palette featuring deep black backgrounds, bright white text, and a signature vibrant red for calls to action, branding, and interactive elements.

The hero background image subtly parallaxes against the foreground text as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth. A temporary promotional banner slides up from the bottom of the viewport on initial scroll, then disappears as scrolling continues. The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the page.

Numbered content cards with poster art are used for the 'Trending Now' section, while icon-driven feature cards with short descriptions are used for the 'More Reasons to Join' section, both maintaining a dark background.
Accordion-style FAQ section with dark grey background panels and a red plus/minus icon for expanding and collapsing answers.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed, dynamic background of movie/show stills that moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect. A dark, transparent overlay ensures text readability.
A persistent top navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, providing access to core actions regardless of scroll depth.

A temporary, scroll-triggered promotional banner animates into view from the bottom of the screen on initial scroll, then animates out as the user scrolls further down the page, using CSS keyframes for its entrance and exit.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) for hero and section titles, with a clear hierarchy down to smaller, regular-weight sans-serif for body and legal text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons, input fields, and some interactive elements; otherwise, sharp corners for content cards and section boundaries.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between main sections and a more dense arrangement for content within card grids.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its immersive, full-bleed hero background of dynamic movie/show stills that subtly parallaxes, immediately conveying the product's core offering. The strong brand red is used strategically for high-impact calls to action, creating a sense of urgency and excitement. The temporary, scroll-triggered promotional banner also adds a unique interactive layer.
